title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - June 01, 2026

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 2:36 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
2026 Municipal Elections Compliance Audit Committee (MECAC), COR-2026-176
notes: The Committee considered Corporate Services Department report COR-2026-176, dated April 13, 2026, recommending that a joint Municipal Elections Compliance Audit Committee be established for the 2026-2030 term of Council; and, that the City Clerk be delegated authority to review and revise the Terms of Reference throughout the term of the Committee in accordance and in consultation with other participating municipalities; and further, that the City Clerk be delegated authority to select, appoint and compensate members of the Municipal Elections Compliance Audit Committee, in consultation with the other participating municipalities.

attachments.name: 2026 Municipal Election Compliance Audit Committee (MECAC) Terms of Reference - COR-2026-176.pdf

items.title: Noise Exemption - Holy Trinity Serbian Church - 700 Fischer Hallman Road - September 5 and 6, 2026, CSD-2026-230
notes: The Committee considered Community Services Department report CSD-2026-230, dated May 12, 2026, recommending that an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted to the Holy Trinity Serbian Orthodox Church for their annual BBQ and Bull Roast.

attachments.name: Noise Exemption, Holy Trinity Serbian Church, 700 Fischer Hallman Rd - September 5 and 6, 2026, CSD-2026-230.pdf

items.title: Noise Exemption - Bingemans Summer Events July 3 - September 26, CSD-2026-229
notes: The Committee considered Community Services Department report CSD-2026-229, dated May 12, 2026, recommending that an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted for several events being held at 425 Bingeman Centre Drive.

attachments.name: NOISE EXEMPTION – BINGEMANS SUMMER EVENTS - CSD-2026-229.pdf

items.title: Savic Homes, 15 Dellroy Avenue - Section 20 Development Charges Complaint - Jurisdiction, FIN-2026-238 (Advertised)
notes:
The Committee considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2026-238, dated May 21, 2026, recommending that the complaint of development charges at 15 Dellroy Avenue be adjourned to no later than August 10, 2026.

Councillors J. Deneault and P. Singh entered the meeting at this time.

R. Hagey was in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee.

attachments.name: Savic Homes, 15 Dellroy Avenue - Section 20 DC Complaint Update - Jurisdiction Hearing - FIN-2026-238.pdf

items.title: Victoria Park Master Plan, INS-2026-194
notes:
The Committee considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2026-194, dated May 11, 2026, recommending approval of the Victoria Park Master Plan.

K. Leasa provided a presentation on this matter and responded to questions from the Committee. D. McGoldrick and M. Parris were also in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee.

items.title: Chandler Mowat Community Centre Renovations, CSD-2026-212
notes:
The Committee considered Community Services Department report CSD-2026-212, dated May 4, 2026, recommending that Council authorize the reallocation of existing capital funding from completed or closed out projects within Neighbourhood Programs and Services and the Corporate Customer Service Division, to help fund interior renovations at the Chandler Mowat Community Centre.

M. Hildebrand was in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee. J. Lautenbach was also in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee.

items.title: Adjournment
notes:
On motion, the meeting adjourned at 3:15 p.m.

Marilyn Mills
Committee Coordinator

motions.item_title: Noise Exemption - Bingemans Summer Events July 3 - September 26, CSD-2026-229
motions.text: it was resolved: "That an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City Of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted to Bingemans for several events being held at 425 Bingeman Centre Drive, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2026-229; and further, That, this noise exemption be subject to the following conditions. Failure to comply with any of these conditions will render the exemption null and void: The event organizers shall respond accordingly to any requests from City staff during the event(s) in order to address community concerns related to noise impacts within adjacent residential areas. The event organizers shall ensure that a designated on-site contact person is available and accessible at all times during the event(s) to communicate with City staff."
motions.text_html:
it was resolved:

"That an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City Of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted to Bingemans for several events being held at 425 Bingeman Centre Drive, as outlined in Community Services Department report CSD-2026-229; and further,

That, this noise exemption be subject to the following conditions. Failure to comply with any of these conditions will render the exemption null and void:

    1. The event organizers shall respond accordingly to any requests from City staff during the event(s) in order to address community concerns related to noise impacts within adjacent residential areas.

       

    2. The event organizers shall ensure that a designated on-site contact person is available and accessible at all times during the event(s) to communicate with City staff."
